template.name: GameManager
template.declaration: // Manages game state and win/lose conditions

query.comment: Property I: The game never reaches a deadlock state

query.formula: E<> (enemy0.ReachedGoal && enemy1.ReachedGoal && enemy2.ReachedGoal && enemy3.ReachedGoal && enemy4.ReachedGoal && enemy5.ReachedGoal)
query.comment: Property II: All enemies can reach the Main Tower
Property III: Circle 0 reaches Main Tower in no more than n*c time units
Property III: Circle 1 reaches Main Tower in no more than n*c + spawn_time
Property III: Circle 2 reaches Main Tower in no more than n*c + spawn_time
Property IV: Square 0 reaches Main Tower in no more than n*s time units
Property IV: Square 1 reaches Main Tower in no more than n*s + spawn_time
Property IV: Square 2 reaches Main Tower in no more than n*s + spawn_time
Property V: All enemies never leave the red path
